name: Wishkeeper's Bargain
source:
What would you give for your deepest wish?

In the space between dreams, the Wishkeeper waits. He trades desires for something more personal than gold, more intimate than secrets.

This short, atmospheric experience explores the tension between mortal need and immortal curiosity, where every choice shimmers with potential… and consequence.

[From [url=https://dillayaart.itch.io/wishkeepers-bargain]itch.io[/url]]
